description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Heartmender.
When Heartmender dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Heartmender.
When Heartmender dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
